title: KMRL Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 70 Apprenticeship Posts
description: Kochi Metro Rail Limited (KMRL) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 70 Apprenticeship Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech, Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Any Degree, or ITI can grab this chance and apply for the KMRL Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salarystructure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
